terms.comment: Short e, as in penus: L&S pĕnārius.

phrases.latin: Quid est hoc, tata? — Orȳza. — Quid hoc? — Collȳra.
phrases.english: What’s this, Dad? — Rice. — What’s this? — Pasta.

phrases.latin: Hae lentēs sunt; hae fabae, hoc cicer, haec farīna, hoc mel, hae ūvae passae.
phrases.english: These are lentils; these are beans, this is chickpeas, this is flour, this is honey, these are raisins.
